sql: SELECT 'so' t, min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders UNION ALL SELECT 'inv', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM finance_invoices UNION ALL SELECT 'pay', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM finance_customer_payments UNION ALL SELECT 'po', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders UNION ALL SELECT 'bill', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills UNION ALL SELECT 'vpay', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM finance_vendor_payments UNION ALL SELECT 'wms', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM wms_inventory_transactions UNION ALL SELECT 'rcpt', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM wms_receipts UNION ALL SELECT 'quote', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM crm_quotes UNION ALL SELECT 'svc', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM crm_service_contacts UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM erp_returns UNION ALL SELECT 'cm', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM finance_credit_memos UNION ALL SELECT 'xfer', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM erp_transfers UNION ALL SELECT 'vcred', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM finance_vendor_credits UNION ALL SELECT 'dim', min(day), max(day), count(*) FROM dim_date
SELECT min(date), max(date), count(*), count(DISTINCT year) FROM dim_date
WITH c AS (SELECT order_id, count(*) n FROM finance_invoices GROUP BY 1) SELECT n, count(*) orders FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices WHERE order_id IS NULL) inv_null_order, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE o.order_id=i.order_id)) inv_orphan, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)) so_uninvoiced, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE i.customer_id<>o.customer_id) cust_mismatch, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE i.branch<>o.branch) branch_mismatch, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE coalesce(i.customer_po,'')<>coalesce(o.customer_po,'')) po_mismatch

WITH u AS (SELECT o.*, d.year FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)) SELECT year, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE day>2480) late FROM u GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fulfilment, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN qty_shipped<qty_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) short, sum(CASE WHEN qty_shipped=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_ship, sum(CASE WHEN ship_day IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ship, avg(markdown_pct) FROM erp_sales_order_lines GROUP BY 1

WITH u AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)), l AS (SELECT u.order_id, count(l.line_id) n, sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='short' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nshort, sum(l.qty_shipped) shipped FROM u LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1) SELECT (n=0) nolines, (nshort=n) allshort, (shipped>0) anyship, count(*) FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id)) orders_no_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id)) orphan_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.line_id=il.line_id)) invline_orphan, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.invoice_id=il.invoice_id)) invline_noheader, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoices i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE i.invoice_id=il.invoice_id)) inv_nolines, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_customers c WHERE c.customer_id=o.customer_id)) so_badcust, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_products p WHERE p.sku=l.sku)) line_badsku

WITH u AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.day, o.branch, o.channel FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id AND l.qty_shipped>0)) SELECT d.year, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.day>2500) last20, count(DISTINCT branch) FROM u JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la, sum(qty*unit_price) qp FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(i.amount-s.la)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hdr_ne_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(s.la-s.qp)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_ne_qtyprice, sum(i.amount) total_billed FROM finance_invoices i JOIN s USING(invoice_id)

WITH s AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la, sum(qty*unit_price) qp FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1), j AS (SELECT i.*, s.la, s.qp, i.amount-s.la diff, d.year FROM finance_invoices i JOIN s USING(invoice_id) JOIN dim_date d USING(day)) SELECT year, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(diff)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hdr_ne, round(sum(diff),2) sumdiff, round(median(CASE WHEN abs(diff)>0.01 THEN diff/nullif(la,0) END),4) med_ratio, sum(CASE WHEN abs(la-qp)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_ne_qp FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) la, sum(qty*unit_price) qp FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT max(abs(i.amount-s.la)) max_hdr_diff, sum(CASE WHEN abs(i.amount-s.la)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hdr_gt1, max(abs(s.la-s.qp)) max_qp_diff, sum(CASE WHEN abs(s.la-s.qp)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qp_gt1 FROM finance_invoices i JOIN s USING(invoice_id)

WITH il AS (SELECT line_id, sum(qty) iq, max(unit_price) ip, min(unit_price) ipmin, count(*) n FROM finance_invoice_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) lines, sum(CASE WHEN il.line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) not_invoiced, sum(CASE WHEN il.line_id IS NULL AND l.qty_shipped>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) shipped_not_inv, sum(CASE WHEN abs(il.iq-l.qty_shipped)>0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_ne_shipped, sum(CASE WHEN il.iq>l.qty_shipped+0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) inv_gt_ship, sum(CASE WHEN abs(il.ip-l.unit_price)>0.005 OR abs(il.ipmin-l.unit_price)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) price_ne, sum(CASE WHEN il.n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_inv_lines FROM erp_sales_order_lines l LEFT JOIN il USING(line_id)

SELECT d.year, count(*) lines, round(sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price),2) value, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.ship_day>2500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ship_last20 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=l.ship_day WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT o.channel, count(*) orders, count(DISTINCT o.taken_by) takers, min(o.day), max(o.day) FROM erp_sales_orders o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT r.role, count(DISTINCT r.rep_id) reps, count(DISTINCT r.branch) branches FROM erp_sales_reps r GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'taken_by_not_in_reps', count(DISTINCT taken_by), NULL FROM erp_sales_orders o WHERE taken_by IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_reps r WHERE r.rep_id=o.taken_by) UNION ALL SELECT 'taken_by_role:'||r.role, count(*), NULL FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_sales_reps r ON r.rep_id=o.taken_by GROUP BY r.role UNION ALL SELECT 'cust_rep_role:'||coalesce(r.role,'none'), count(*), NULL FROM erp_customers c LEFT JOIN erp_sales_reps r USING(rep_id) GROUP BY r.role

SELECT count(*) shipped_noinv_lines, sum(CASE WHEN unit_price=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_price, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment='special' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) special, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment='transfer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) xfer, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment='stock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) stock FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_sales_reps r ON r.rep_id=o.taken_by WHERE r.branch<>o.branch) taker_other_branch, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.branch<>o.branch) order_branch_ne_cust_branch, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_customers c JOIN erp_sales_reps r USING(rep_id) WHERE c.branch<>r.branch) cust_rep_other_branch, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.day<c.onboarded_day) order_before_onboard, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_sales_orders WHERE customer_po IS NULL OR customer_po='') no_cust_po

SELECT trade, count(*) n, min(terms_days), max(terms_days), count(DISTINCT terms_days) nterms, round(avg(credit_limit)) avg_cl, round(min(discount_pct),3) mind, round(max(discount_pct),3) maxd, count(DISTINCT discount_pct) ndisc, min(onboarded_day), max(onboarded_day) FROM erp_customers GROUP BY ROLLUP(trade) ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH x AS (SELECT l.unit_price, l.unit_cost, l.markdown_pct, p.list_price, p.unit_cost pc, c.discount_pct, l.fulfilment FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) USING SAMPLE 200000 ROWS) SELECT fulfilment, count(*), avg(CASE WHEN abs(unit_price - list_price*(1-discount_pct)*(1-markdown_pct))<0.02 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) match_ld_md, avg(CASE WHEN abs(unit_price - list_price*(1-markdown_pct))<0.02 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) match_md, avg(CASE WHEN abs(unit_cost-pc)<0.005 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) cost_eq_prod, avg(CASE WHEN markdown_pct>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) any_md, avg(unit_price/list_price) avg_price_to_list FROM x GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*) skus, sum(CASE WHEN nc>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) skus_cost_varies, sum(CASE WHEN np>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) skus_price_varies, median(np) med_distinct_prices FROM (SELECT sku, count(DISTINCT unit_cost) nc, count(DISTINCT unit_price) np FROM erp_sales_order_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) skus, count(DISTINCT sku) d, sum(CASE WHEN nc>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) po_cost_varies FROM (SELECT sku, count(DISTINCT unit_cost) nc FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1)

WITH p AS (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) n, sum(amount) amt, min(day) d1, max(day) d2 FROM finance_customer_payments GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) invoices, sum(CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unpaid, sum(CASE WHEN p.n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_pay, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.amt-i.amount)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_exact, sum(CASE WHEN p.amt<i.amount-0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) underpaid, sum(CASE WHEN p.amt>i.amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overpaid, round(sum(i.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.invoice_id IS NULL),2) unpaid_amt FROM finance_invoices i LEFT JOIN p USING(invoice_id)

SELECT method, count(*), round(sum(amount),2), sum(CASE WHEN invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_inv, sum(CASE WHEN amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos FROM finance_customer_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT d.year, count(*) inv, sum(CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unpaid, round(sum(CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NULL THEN i.amount END),2) unpaid_amt, round(avg(p.day-i.day),1) avg_days_to_pay, round(avg(i.due_day-i.day),1) avg_terms, round(avg(CASE WHEN p.day>i.due_day THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL),3) late_share, sum(CASE WHEN p.customer_id<>i.customer_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cust_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN p.day<i.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_before_inv FROM finance_invoices i JOIN dim_date d USING(day) LEFT JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.terms_days, count(*) inv, round(avg(i.due_day-i.day),2) avg_due_gap, min(i.due_day-i.day), max(i.due_day-i.day), round(avg(p.day-i.day),1) avg_pay_days FROM finance_invoices i JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) LEFT JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN i.day>2460 THEN 'last60' WHEN i.day>2400 THEN '61-120' ELSE 'older' END bucket, count(*), round(sum(i.amount),2), min(i.day), count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM finance_invoices i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_customer_payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id) GROUP BY 1

SELECT r.reason_code, count(*) n, count(cm.credit_id) memos_same_order_day FROM erp_returns r LEFT JOIN finance_credit_memos cm ON cm.order_id=r.order_id AND cm.day=r.day GROUP BY ROLLUP(1) ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT reason, count(*), round(sum(amount),2), round(min(amount),2), round(max(amount),2), sum(CASE WHEN order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order FROM finance_credit_memos GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH r AS (SELECT r.*, l.unit_price, l.qty_shipped, l.order_id lo, l.sku lsku, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.order_id, r.day ORDER BY r.return_id) rn FROM erp_returns r LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id)), c AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, day ORDER BY credit_id) rn FROM finance_credit_memos) SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN lo<>r.order_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) line_order_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN lsku<>r.sku THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN r.qty>qty_shipped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ret_gt_shipped, sum(CASE WHEN abs(c.amount - r.qty*r.unit_price)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) memo_eq_qtyprice, sum(CASE WHEN c.reason=r.reason_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) reason_same, round(sum(c.amount - r.qty*r.unit_price),2) diff, sum(CASE WHEN c.credit_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_memo FROM r LEFT JOIN c ON c.order_id=r.order_id AND c.day=r.day AND c.rn=r.rn

SELECT reason, count(*), round(sum(qty_delta)), min(day), max(day), sum(CASE WHEN ref_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ref, sum(CASE WHEN qty_delta>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pos, sum(CASE WHEN qty_delta<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale') SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN l.line_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ref_is_line, sum(CASE WHEN l.sku=s.sku THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_eq, sum(CASE WHEN abs(-s.qty_delta-l.qty_shipped)<0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_eq, sum(CASE WHEN s.day=l.ship_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_eq, sum(CASE WHEN o.branch=s.branch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) branch_eq, sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='special' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) special FROM s LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l ON l.line_id=s.ref_id LEFT JOIN erp_sales_orders o ON o.order_id=l.order_id
SELECT purpose, count(*) pos, round(avg(expected_day-day),1) avg_lead_exp, count(DISTINCT vendor_id) vendors, min(day), max(day) FROM erp_purchase_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' USING SAMPLE 100000 ROWS) SELECT count(*) n, count(o.order_id) ref_is_order, sum(CASE WHEN o.branch=s.branch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) branch_eq, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id=s.ref_id AND l.sku=s.sku) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_in_order, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id=s.ref_id AND l.sku=s.sku AND l.ship_day=s.day AND abs(l.qty_shipped+s.qty_delta)<0.001) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) full_match FROM s LEFT JOIN erp_sales_orders o ON o.order_id=s.ref_id

WITH s AS (SELECT ref_id order_id, sku, sum(-qty_delta) q, min(day) d1, max(day) d2, count(*) n FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' GROUP BY 1,2), l AS (SELECT order_id, sku, sum(qty_shipped) q, min(ship_day) d1, max(ship_day) d2, count(*) n FROM erp_sales_order_lines WHERE qty_shipped>0 AND fulfilment<>'special' GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN s.order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) erp_only, sum(CASE WHEN l.order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wms_only, sum(CASE WHEN abs(s.q-l.q)>0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_ne, sum(CASE WHEN s.d1<>l.d1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_ne, round(avg(s.d1-l.d1) FILTER (WHERE s.d1<>l.d1),2) avg_daydiff FROM s FULL JOIN l USING(order_id, sku)

WITH r AS (SELECT sku, branch, day, sum(sum(qty_delta)) OVER (PARTITION BY sku, branch ORDER BY day) bal FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY sku, branch, day) SELECT count(DISTINCT sku||branch) skubranch, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bal< -0.001 THEN sku||branch END) ever_negative, sum(CASE WHEN bal< -0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_days, min(bal) FROM r

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_receipts r WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id)) po_no_receipt, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE purpose='stock' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_receipts r WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id)) stockpo_no_receipt, (SELECT count(*) FROM wms_receipts r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id)) rcpt_orphan, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT po_id FROM wms_receipts GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) po_multi_rcpt, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE b.po_id=po.po_id)) po_no_bill, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE b.po_id=po.po_id)) bill_orphan, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) po_multi_bill, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_payments p WHERE b.bill_id=p.bill_id)) bill_unpaid, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT bill_id FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) bill_multi_pay

WITH m AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1), b AS (SELECT b.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.po_id ORDER BY b.day, b.bill_id) rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY b.po_id) n FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN m USING(po_id)) SELECT n, count(*) bills, count(DISTINCT po_id) pos, count(DISTINCT vendor_invoice_no) dist_vinv, count(DISTINCT vendor_id) vendors, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_vendor_payments p WHERE p.bill_id=b.bill_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid FROM b GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.year, count(*) stock_po_no_rcpt, sum(CASE WHEN po.expected_day>2520 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) expected_after_end FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN dim_date d USING(day) WHERE purpose='stock' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_receipts r WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pov AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) v FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT b.*, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY po_id) n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rn FROM finance_vendor_bills b) SELECT n, rn, count(*) bills, sum(CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-pov.v)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_eq_po, sum(CASE WHEN b.amount>pov.v+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_gt_po, sum(CASE WHEN b.amount<pov.v-0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_lt_po, round(sum(b.amount-pov.v),2) sum_diff, round(avg(freight),2) avg_freight FROM b JOIN pov USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) v FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1), pov AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) v FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) bills, count(bl.bill_id) with_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-bl.v)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_eq_lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-bl.v-b.freight)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_eq_lines_plus_freight, sum(CASE WHEN abs(bl.v-pov.v)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_eq_po, sum(CASE WHEN bl.v>pov.v+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_gt_po, sum(CASE WHEN b.freight>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_freight FROM finance_vendor_bills b LEFT JOIN bl USING(bill_id) JOIN pov USING(po_id)

WITH bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.po_id, l.sku, sum(l.qty) q, max(l.unit_cost) c FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) GROUP BY 1,2,3), pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) q, max(unit_cost) c FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT count(*) bill_sku, sum(CASE WHEN pl.po_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_not_on_po, sum(CASE WHEN bl.q>pl.q+0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_gt, sum(CASE WHEN bl.q<pl.q-0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_lt, sum(CASE WHEN bl.c>pl.c+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_gt, sum(CASE WHEN bl.c<pl.c-0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_lt, round(median(bl.c/pl.c) FILTER (WHERE bl.c>pl.c+0.005),4) med_cost_ratio FROM bl LEFT JOIN pl USING(po_id, sku)

WITH pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, sum(qty) q FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2), rc AS (SELECT ref_id po_id, sku, sum(qty_delta) q, count(*) n FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='receipt' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT po_id FROM wms_receipts) SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN pl.po_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rcv_not_on_po, sum(CASE WHEN rc.po_id IS NULL AND pl.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM r) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) po_line_not_rcvd_on_rcpt_po, sum(CASE WHEN rc.q>pl.q+0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_rcv, sum(CASE WHEN rc.q<pl.q-0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) under_rcv FROM pl FULL JOIN rc USING(po_id, sku)

WITH bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, b.day, l.sku, l.qty bq, l.unit_cost bc FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)), pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, qty, unit_cost FROM erp_purchase_order_lines), j AS (SELECT bl.*, (bl.bq>pl.qty+0.001) qgt, (bl.bc>pl.unit_cost+0.005) cgt FROM bl JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) JOIN pl ON pl.po_id=b.po_id AND pl.sku=bl.sku) SELECT d.year, count(*) lines, sum(qgt::int) qty_over, sum(cgt::int) cost_over, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cgt THEN vendor_id END) vendors_cost_over, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qgt THEN vendor_id END) vendors_qty_over FROM j JOIN dim_date d USING(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) pays, sum(CASE WHEN abs(p.amount-b.amount)<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) eq_bill, sum(CASE WHEN p.amount<b.amount-0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lt_bill, sum(CASE WHEN p.vendor_id<>b.vendor_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vend_mismatch, round(avg(p.day-b.day),1) avg_days, round(avg(v.terms_days),1) avg_terms_cal, sum(CASE WHEN p.day<b.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid_before_bill FROM finance_vendor_payments p JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) JOIN erp_vendors v ON v.vendor_id=b.vendor_id

FROM finance_vendor_payments p JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) JOIN erp_vendors v ON v.vendor_id=b.vendor_id JOIN dim_date dd1 ON dd1.day=b.day JOIN dim_date dd2 ON dd2.day=p.day GROUP BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT amount) na, count(DISTINCT vendor_invoice_no) ni FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT n, na, ni, count(*) pos FROM b GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY pos DESC

SELECT d.year, count(*) lines, avg(l.markdown_pct) avg_md, avg((l.markdown_pct>0)::int) share_md,
 sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price) rev_ord, sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)) md_dollars,
 sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price)/sum(l.qty_ordered*p.list_price) realisation,
 1-sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_cost)/sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price) gm
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sku, count(*) n FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
pl AS (SELECT po_id, sku, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bl WHERE n>1) dup_bill_sku, (SELECT count(*) FROM pl WHERE n>1) dup_po_sku,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) LEFT JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku WHERE p.po_id IS NULL) bill_lines_no_po_line,
(SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id HAVING count(*)>1 LIMIT 1) multi_pay

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, count(*) np, sum(amount) pamt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id)
SELECT rk, count(*) bills, count(p.bill_id) paid, sum(b.amount) billed, sum(p.pamt) paid_amt, sum(CASE WHEN p.pamt<b.amount-0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) short_paid, max(np) maxpay, avg(b.day - lag_day) avg_gap
FROM (SELECT *, lag(day) OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY rk) lag_day FROM b) b LEFT JOIN p USING (bill_id) GROUP BY rk ORDER BY rk

SELECT d.year, d.quarter, count(*) n, avg((l.markdown_pct>0)::int) share_md, avg(l.markdown_pct) avg_md, avg(CASE WHEN l.markdown_pct>0 THEN l.markdown_pct END) avg_md_when_any
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE d.year>=2022 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT p.category, d.year>=2023 post, count(*) n, avg((l.markdown_pct>0)::int) share_md, avg(l.markdown_pct) avg_md, sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)) md_dollars
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE d.year IN (2022,2025) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH d AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT po.purpose, count(*) pos, count(r.po_id) with_receipt, max(rc.nr) max_receipts
FROM d JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING (po_id)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT po_id, count(*) nr FROM wms_receipts GROUP BY po_id) rc USING (po_id)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM wms_receipts) r USING (po_id)
GROUP BY ALL

WITH x AS (
SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, d.year, l.sku, l.qty bq, l.unit_cost bc, p.qty pq, p.unit_cost pc,
 l.qty*l.unit_cost - p.qty*p.unit_cost diff,
 CASE WHEN vp.bill_id IS NULL THEN 'unpaid' WHEN abs(vp.amount-b.amount)<0.01 THEN 'full' ELSE 'short' END pay
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=b.day
LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp ON vp.bill_id=b.bill_id)
SELECT pay, count(*) lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN bq>pq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_over, sum(CASE WHEN bq<pq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_under,
 sum(CASE WHEN bc>pc+1e-6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_over, sum(CASE WHEN bc<pc-1e-6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_under,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) excess, round(sum(CASE WHEN diff<-0.005 THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) shortfall
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.year, round(l.markdown_pct,3) md, count(*) n
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day
WHERE l.markdown_pct>0 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.year, p.refrigerant, (p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND o.order_date>=p.discontinued_on) after_disc, count(*) n, avg((l.markdown_pct>0)::int) share_md, sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)) md_dollars
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND d.year>=2021 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
l AS (SELECT b.po_id, b.rk, string_agg(bl.sku||':'||bl.qty||':'||bl.unit_cost, '|' ORDER BY bl.sku) sig FROM b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines bl USING (bill_id) GROUP BY ALL),
pl AS (SELECT po_id, string_agg(sku||':'||qty, '|' ORDER BY sku) psig FROM erp_purchase_order_lines GROUP BY po_id),
l2 AS (SELECT po_id, string_agg(sku||':'||qty, '|' ORDER BY sku) sig2 FROM b JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines bl USING (bill_id) WHERE rk=2 GROUP BY po_id)
SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN a.sig=c.sig THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) identical_lines, sum(CASE WHEN l2.sig2=pl.psig THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) second_eq_po_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN b1.freight=b2.freight THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_freight
FROM l a JOIN l c ON a.po_id=c.po_id AND a.rk=1 AND c.rk=2 JOIN pl ON pl.po_id=a.po_id JOIN l2 ON l2.po_id=a.po_id
JOIN b b1 ON b1.po_id=a.po_id AND b1.rk=1 JOIN b b2 ON b2.po_id=a.po_id AND b2.rk=2
SELECT reason, count(*), sum(qty_delta), min(day), max(day) FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1

WITH x AS (
SELECT b.bill_id, b.vendor_id, d.year, l.sku, l.qty bq, l.unit_cost bc, p.qty pq, p.unit_cost pc,
 l.qty*l.unit_cost - p.qty*p.unit_cost diff
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=b.day
JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp ON vp.bill_id=b.bill_id AND abs(vp.amount-b.amount)<0.01)
SELECT year, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT bill_id) bills,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN diff>0.005 THEN bill_id END) over_bills,
 sum(CASE WHEN bq>pq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_over_lines, sum(CASE WHEN bc>pc+1e-6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_over_lines,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 AND bq>pq THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) qty_excess,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 AND bq<=pq THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) cost_excess,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) excess,
 round(sum(p_val),2) po_value
FROM (SELECT *, pq*pc p_val FROM x) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, amount pamt FROM finance_vendor_payments)
SELECT d.year, count(*) second_bills, count(p.bill_id) paid, round(count(p.bill_id)/count(*),3) paid_rate, round(sum(p.pamt),2) paid_amt, round(sum(b.amount),2) billed
FROM b JOIN dim_date d USING (day) LEFT JOIN p USING (bill_id) WHERE rk=2 GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY 1

SELECT (p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND o.order_date>=p.discontinued_on) after_disc, (l.markdown_pct>0) has_md, p.category, count(*) n
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT substr(discontinued_on,1,4) yr, category, refrigerant, count(*) skus FROM erp_products WHERE discontinued_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, amount pamt FROM finance_vendor_payments),
v AS (SELECT b.vendor_id, count(*) n, count(p.bill_id) paid, sum(p.pamt) amt FROM b LEFT JOIN p USING (bill_id) WHERE rk=2 GROUP BY 1),
allb AS (SELECT vendor_id, count(*) nb FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) vendors, min(n) min_n, max(n) max_n, min(paid*1.0/n) min_rate, max(paid*1.0/n) max_rate, max(amt)/sum(amt) top_vendor_share_amt,
 min(n*1.0/nb) min_dup_per_bill, max(n*1.0/nb) max_dup_per_bill,
 (SELECT sum(amt) FROM (SELECT amt FROM v ORDER BY amt DESC LIMIT 5))/sum(amt) top5_share
FROM v JOIN allb USING (vendor_id)

WITH p AS (
 SELECT t.sku, t.branch, sum(qty_delta) oh,
  -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>2268 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s252,
  -sum(CASE WHEN reason IN ('sale','transfer out') AND day>2268 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) u252,
  max(CASE WHEN reason='opening' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_open
 FROM wms_inventory_transactions t GROUP BY 1,2),
v AS (SELECT p.*, p.oh*pr.unit_cost val, pr.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL disc, pr.category FROM p JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku))
SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN oh>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pairs_pos, round(sum(val),0) total_val,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s252<=0 AND oh>0.01 THEN val END),0) dead_val,
 sum(CASE WHEN s252<=0 AND oh>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dead_pairs,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN u252<=0 AND oh>0.01 THEN val END),0) dead_val_incl_xfer,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s252>0 AND oh>2*s252 THEN (oh-2*s252)*val/oh END),0) excess_above2y_val,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s252>0 AND oh>2*s252 THEN val END),0) excess_pairs_fullval,
 sum(CASE WHEN s252>0 AND oh>2*s252 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) excess_pairs,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN oh>0.01 AND (s252<=0 OR oh>2*s252) THEN val END),0) dead_or_excess_fullval
FROM v

SELECT p.discontinued_on, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, min(o.order_date) first_sale_after, max(o.order_date) last_sale, count(*) lines_after, sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)) md_dollars
FROM erp_products p LEFT JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l ON l.sku=p.sku LEFT JOIN erp_sales_orders o ON o.order_id=l.order_id AND o.order_date>=p.discontinued_on
WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
SELECT b.vendor_id, l.sku, b.day, l.unit_cost/p.unit_cost r, (l.unit_cost>p.unit_cost+1e-6) co
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku),
f AS (SELECT vendor_id, sku, min(day) fd FROM x WHERE co GROUP BY 1,2),
s AS (SELECT x.vendor_id, x.sku, count(*) n_after, sum(co::int) co_after,
  count(DISTINCT round(r,4)) FILTER (WHERE co) distinct_ratios
  FROM x JOIN f USING(vendor_id, sku) WHERE x.day>f.fd GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) vendor_skus_with_overprice, (SELECT count(DISTINCT vendor_id||'-'||sku) FROM x) all_vendor_skus,
 sum(n_after) lines_after_first, sum(co_after) overpriced_after_first, round(sum(co_after)/sum(n_after),4) share_after,
 (SELECT round(avg(co::int),4) FROM x) base_share,
 sum(CASE WHEN co_after>=0.9*n_after THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) skus_step_like,
 (SELECT round(quantile_cont(r,0.1),4)||' / '||round(quantile_cont(r,0.5),4)||' / '||round(quantile_cont(r,0.9),4) FROM x WHERE co) ratio_p10_p50_p90
FROM s

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, amount pamt FROM finance_vendor_payments)
SELECT v.kind, count(*) second_bills, count(p.bill_id) paid, round(sum(p.pamt),2) paid_amt, round(sum(p.pamt)/sum(sum(p.pamt)) OVER (),3) share,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills fb JOIN erp_vendors v2 USING(vendor_id) WHERE v2.kind=v.kind) all_bills
FROM b JOIN erp_vendors v USING (vendor_id) LEFT JOIN p USING (bill_id) WHERE rk=2 GROUP BY v.kind

WITH p AS (
 SELECT t.sku, t.branch, sum(qty_delta) oh,
  -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>2268 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s252,
  max(CASE WHEN reason='opening' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_open,
  max(CASE WHEN reason='receipt' AND day>2268 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rec252
 FROM wms_inventory_transactions t GROUP BY 1,2),
v AS (SELECT p.*, p.oh*pr.unit_cost val, pr.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL disc, pr.category,
  CASE WHEN oh<=0.01 THEN 'none' WHEN s252<=0 THEN 'dead' WHEN oh>2*s252 THEN 'excess' ELSE 'ok' END cls
  FROM p JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku))
SELECT category, disc, has_open, cls, count(*) pairs, round(sum(val),0) val, round(sum(CASE WHEN cls='excess' THEN (oh-2*s252)*val/oh WHEN cls='dead' THEN val ELSE 0 END),0) over2y_val, sum(rec252) pairs_rcv_last252
FROM v GROUP BY ROLLUP(category, disc, has_open, cls) HAVING cls IS NOT NULL OR category IS NULL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
sp AS (SELECT b.*, p.day pday, p.amount pamt FROM b JOIN finance_vendor_payments p USING (bill_id) WHERE rk=2),
m AS (SELECT sp.bill_id,
  max(CASE WHEN abs(c.amount-sp.amount)<=0.01*sp.amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_match_1pct,
  max(CASE WHEN abs(c.amount-(sp.amount-sp.freight))<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_match_exfreight,
  count(c.vendor_credit_id) any_credit_n,
  sum(c.amount) credit_sum
 FROM sp LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_credits c ON c.vendor_id=sp.vendor_id AND c.day BETWEEN sp.pday AND sp.pday+250 GROUP BY sp.bill_id)
SELECT count(*) paid_second, sum(amt_match_1pct) amt_match_1pct, sum(amt_match_exfreight) exfreight_match, sum(CASE WHEN any_credit_n>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) any_vendor_credit_within_250d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_credits) total_credits, (SELECT round(sum(amount),2) FROM finance_vendor_credits) total_credit_amt
FROM m

SELECT substr(p.discontinued_on,1,4) wave, (o.day - dd.day)//21 months_since, count(*) n, avg(l.markdown_pct) avg_md, min(l.markdown_pct) mn, max(l.markdown_pct) mx
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.date = (SELECT min(date) FROM dim_date WHERE date>=CAST(p.discontinued_on AS DATE))
WHERE o.order_date>=p.discontinued_on AND substr(p.discontinued_on,1,4) IN ('2023','2025')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
SELECT b.vendor_id, v.kind, d.year, l.qty*l.unit_cost - p.qty*p.unit_cost diff, p.qty*p.unit_cost pv, (l.unit_cost>p.unit_cost+1e-6 OR l.qty>p.qty) o
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=b.day JOIN erp_vendors v ON v.vendor_id=b.vendor_id
JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp ON vp.bill_id=b.bill_id AND abs(vp.amount-b.amount)<0.01),
v AS (SELECT vendor_id, kind, sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 THEN diff ELSE 0 END) ex, sum(pv) pv, avg(o::int) rate FROM x GROUP BY 1,2),
vy AS (SELECT vendor_id, year, avg(o::int) rate FROM x GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT kind, count(*) vendors, round(sum(ex),2) excess, round(sum(ex)/sum(pv),5) excess_per_po_dollar,
 round(min(rate),4) min_vendor_line_rate, round(max(rate),4) max_vendor_line_rate,
 (SELECT round(min(rate),4)||' - '||round(max(rate),4) FROM vy) vendor_year_rate_range,
 (SELECT round(max(ex)/sum(ex) ,4) FROM v v2 ) top_vendor_share_all
FROM v GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

WITH dup AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1),
b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb),
sp AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.po_id, b.vendor_id, b.amount, p.day pday, (b.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM dup) AND rk=2) is_dup2 FROM b JOIN finance_vendor_payments p USING (bill_id) WHERE rk = CASE WHEN b.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM dup) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END),
m AS (SELECT sp.bill_id, sp.is_dup2,
  max(CASE WHEN abs(c.amount-sp.amount)<=0.01*sp.amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt1,
  max(CASE WHEN c.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines bl WHERE bl.bill_id=sp.bill_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_match,
  max(CASE WHEN abs(c.amount-sp.amount)<=0.01*sp.amount AND c.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines bl WHERE bl.bill_id=sp.bill_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_and_sku
 FROM sp LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_credits c ON c.vendor_id=sp.vendor_id AND c.day BETWEEN sp.pday AND sp.pday+250 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT is_dup2, count(*) bills, round(avg(amt1),4) rate_amt1pct, round(avg(sku_match),4) rate_sku, sum(amt_and_sku) n_amt_and_sku, round(avg(amt_and_sku),5) rate_amt_and_sku FROM m GROUP BY 1

WITH x AS (
SELECT b.vendor_id, b.po_id, l.sku, b.day, l.qty bq, p.qty pq, l.unit_cost bc, p.unit_cost pc, l.qty*l.unit_cost - p.qty*p.unit_cost diff
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp ON vp.bill_id=b.bill_id AND abs(vp.amount-b.amount)<0.01
WHERE l.qty*l.unit_cost - p.qty*p.unit_cost>0.005),
c AS (SELECT c.*, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_inventory_transactions w JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=w.ref_id
   WHERE w.reason='return_vendor' AND po.vendor_id=c.vendor_id AND w.sku=c.sku AND abs(-w.qty_delta-c.qty)<1e-6 AND c.day BETWEEN w.day AND w.day+60) matched FROM finance_vendor_credits c),
m AS (SELECT count(*) n, sum(c.amount) amt FROM c WHERE NOT matched AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.vendor_id=c.vendor_id AND x.sku=c.sku AND c.day BETWEEN x.day AND x.day+120))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c) credits, (SELECT round(sum(amount),2) FROM c) credit_amt,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM c WHERE NOT matched) unmatched, (SELECT round(sum(amount),2) FROM c WHERE NOT matched) unmatched_amt,
 (SELECT n FROM m) unmatched_near_overbill, (SELECT round(amt,2) FROM m) unmatched_near_overbill_amt,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x) overbill_lines, (SELECT round(sum(diff),2) FROM x) overbill_excess

SELECT p.discontinued_on wave, po.purpose, (po.order_date>=p.discontinued_on) after_disc, count(*) po_lines, sum(pl.qty*pl.unit_cost) po_value
FROM erp_purchase_order_lines pl JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH p AS (
 SELECT t.sku, t.branch, sum(qty_delta) oh,
  -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' AND day>2268 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s252,
  -sum(CASE WHEN reason='sale' THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) s_all,
  -sum(CASE WHEN reason='transfer out' THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) xo_all,
  max(CASE WHEN reason='sale' THEN day END) last_sale,
  min(CASE WHEN reason='receipt' THEN day END) first_rcv,
  max(CASE WHEN reason='receipt' THEN day END) last_rcv,
  sum(CASE WHEN reason='receipt' AND day>2268 THEN qty_delta ELSE 0 END) rcv252
 FROM wms_inventory_transactions t GROUP BY 1,2),
v AS (SELECT p.*, p.oh*pr.unit_cost val, pr.category FROM p JOIN erp_products pr USING(sku) WHERE oh>0.01 AND s252<=0)
SELECT category, count(*) pairs, round(sum(val),0) val,
 sum(CASE WHEN s_all=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) never_sold, round(sum(CASE WHEN s_all=0 THEN val END),0) never_sold_val,
 sum(CASE WHEN xo_all>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_xfer_out,
 median(first_rcv) med_first_rcv, median(last_rcv) med_last_rcv, median(last_sale) med_last_sale, round(sum(rcv252),0) rcv252_qty, round(sum(oh),0) oh_qty
FROM v GROUP BY ROLLUP(category)

SELECT count(*) sku_days, sum((nd>1)::int) sku_days_multi_md FROM (

 min(first_rcv) min_first_rcv, max(first_rcv) max_first_rcv, (SELECT date FROM dim_date WHERE day=2412) d2412,

WITH bl AS (

dup AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1),

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
x AS (SELECT b1.vendor_invoice_no i1, b2.vendor_invoice_no i2, b2.day d2, p1.day p1day, p2.day p2day, p2.bill_id IS NOT NULL paid2 FROM b b1 JOIN b b2 ON b1.po_id=b2.po_id AND b1.rk=1 AND b2.rk=2

WITH p AS (

SELECT CASE WHEN af THEN 'R454B new (af 2025)' WHEN disc AND category='equipment' THEN 'discontinued equipment' ELSE 'other' END seg,
 count(*) pairs, round(sum(val),0) val,

SELECT d.year,
 sum(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct)) md_dollars_recorded_all,

 sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' AND l.markdown_pct>0 THEN l.qty_shipped*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost) ELSE 0 END) gp_md_stock_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' AND l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) md_stock_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment<>'stock' AND l.markdown_pct>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) md_other_lines,
 avg(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment<>'stock' AND l.markdown_pct>0 THEN l.unit_price/p.list_price END) other_price_to_list

WITH y AS (SELECT DISTINCT year, max(day) OVER (PARTITION BY year) d FROM dim_date),

 FROM y JOIN wms_inventory_transactions t ON t.day<=y.d GROUP BY 1,2,3,4),

 round(sum(CASE WHEN s252<=0 THEN val ELSE 0 END),0) dead_val,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s252>0 AND oh>2*s252 THEN (oh-2*s252)*uc ELSE 0 END),0) excess_over2y,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s252<=0 THEN val WHEN oh>2*s252 THEN (oh-2*s252)*uc ELSE 0 END)/sum(val),4) share_over2y,
 round(c.cogs,0) cogs_year, round(sum(val)/c.cogs*12,2) months_of_cogs
FROM v JOIN cogs c USING(year) GROUP BY v.year, v.d, c.cogs ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (
 SELECT o.branch, d.year, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) rev, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) orders,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment='stock' THEN l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price*l.markdown_pct/(1-l.markdown_pct) ELSE 0 END)/sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) md_rate
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day WHERE d.year IN (2022,2025) GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT branch, max(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN md_rate END)-max(CASE WHEN year=2022 THEN md_rate END) d_md,

WITH y AS (SELECT year, max(day) d FROM dim_date GROUP BY 1),

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),

 round(sum(CASE WHEN discontinued_on IS NOT NULL THEN oh*uc END),0) disc_val,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN available_from IS NOT NULL THEN oh*uc END),0) new_val,
 round(0.20*sum(oh*uc),0) carry_20pct, round(sum(oh*uc)/32929865,4) share_total
FROM v

WITH bl AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(qty*unit_cost) lv FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) bills, sum(CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-(bl.lv+b.freight))<0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_eq_lines_plus_freight,
sum(CASE WHEN abs(b.amount-bl.lv)<0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_eq_lines,
sum(CASE WHEN bl.bill_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines,
round(sum(b.freight),2) freight, round(sum(b.amount),2) amount
FROM finance_vendor_bills b LEFT JOIN bl USING(bill_id)
SELECT reason, count(*), count(DISTINCT ref_id), round(sum(qty_delta),0) FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders) pos, (SELECT count(DISTINCT po_id) FROM finance_vendor_bills) billed_pos, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills) bills,
(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_pos,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT po_id) FROM wms_receipts) received_pos, (SELECT count(*) FROM wms_receipts) receipts,
(SELECT purpose||':'||count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1) p1,
(SELECT string_agg(purpose||':'||n, ', ') FROM (SELECT purpose, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_orders GROUP BY 1)) purposes

WITH rq AS (SELECT r.po_id, w.sku, sum(w.qty_delta) rq, count(DISTINCT r.receipt_id) nrec FROM wms_receipts r JOIN wms_inventory_transactions w ON w.ref_id=r.receipt_id AND w.reason='receipt' GROUP BY 1,2),
x AS (SELECT po.purpose, l.qty bq, p.qty pq, rq.rq, l.unit_cost bc, p.unit_cost pc
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=b.po_id
LEFT JOIN rq ON rq.po_id=b.po_id AND rq.sku=l.sku)
SELECT purpose, count(*) lines, sum((rq IS NULL)::int) no_receipt, sum((rq=pq)::int) rec_eq_po, sum((rq<pq)::int) rec_lt_po, sum((rq>pq)::int) rec_gt_po,
sum((bq>pq)::int) qty_over, sum((bq>pq AND rq IS NULL)::int) qty_over_no_receipt, sum((bq>pq AND rq>=bq)::int) qty_over_received,
sum((bc>pc+1e-6)::int) cost_over
FROM x GROUP BY 1

SELECT w.ref_id, count(*), min(w.day), max(w.day), (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_purchase_orders po WHERE po.po_id=w.ref_id) is_po, (SELECT count(*) FROM wms_receipts r WHERE r.receipt_id=w.ref_id) is_receipt FROM wms_inventory_transactions w WHERE reason='return_vendor' GROUP BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) pamt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
x AS (SELECT b2.*, po.branch, po.purpose, p2.bill_id IS NOT NULL paid2, p1.pday - b1.day lag1, p2.pday-b2.day lag2 FROM b b1 JOIN b b2 ON b1.po_id=b2.po_id AND b1.rk=1 AND b2.rk=2 JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=b2.po_id LEFT JOIN p p1 ON p1.bill_id=b1.bill_id LEFT JOIN p p2 ON p2.bill_id=b2.bill_id WHERE b2.day <= 2520-45)
SELECT 'amount' dim, CASE WHEN amount<500 THEN 'a <500' WHEN amount<2000 THEN 'b 500-2k' WHEN amount<5000 THEN 'c 2k-5k' ELSE 'd 5k+' END grp, count(*) n, sum(paid2::int) paid, round(avg(paid2::int),3) rate FROM x GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'branch', branch, count(*), sum(paid2::int), round(avg(paid2::int),3) FROM x GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'purpose', purpose, count(*), sum(paid2::int), round(avg(paid2::int),3) FROM x GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'lag_equal', (lag1=lag2)::varchar, count(*), sum(paid2::int), round(avg(paid2::int),3) FROM x WHERE paid2 GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id)
SELECT v.terms_days, count(*) bills, count(DISTINCT p.pday-b.day) distinct_lags, min(p.pday-b.day) minlag, max(p.pday-b.day) maxlag, round(avg(p.pday-b.day),2) avglag
FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) JOIN p USING(bill_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM wms_inventory_transactions w JOIN wms_receipts r ON r.receipt_id=w.ref_id WHERE w.reason='receipt') join_receipt_id,
(SELECT count(*) FROM wms_inventory_transactions w JOIN wms_receipts r ON r.po_id=w.ref_id WHERE w.reason='receipt') join_po_id,
(SELECT count(*) FROM wms_inventory_transactions w JOIN wms_receipts r ON r.po_id=w.ref_id AND r.day=w.day AND r.branch=w.branch WHERE w.reason='receipt') join_po_day_branch,
(SELECT min(receipt_id)||'-'||max(receipt_id) FROM wms_receipts) rid_range, (SELECT min(ref_id)||'-'||max(ref_id) FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='receipt') ref_range,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT vendor_id) FROM finance_vendor_credits) credit_vendors

WITH rq AS (SELECT ref_id po_id, sku, sum(qty_delta) rq FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='receipt' GROUP BY 1,2),
x AS (SELECT po.purpose, l.qty bq, p.qty pq, rq.rq, l.unit_cost bc, p.unit_cost pc, l.qty*l.unit_cost-p.qty*p.unit_cost diff,
 CASE WHEN vp.bill_id IS NULL THEN 'unpaid' WHEN abs(vp.amount-b.amount)<0.01 THEN 'full' ELSE 'short' END pay
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku
JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=b.po_id
LEFT JOIN rq ON rq.po_id=b.po_id AND rq.sku=l.sku
LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp ON vp.bill_id=b.bill_id)
SELECT purpose, pay, count(*) lines, sum((rq IS NULL)::int) no_receipt, sum((rq=pq)::int) rec_eq_po, sum((rq<pq)::int) rec_lt_po, sum((rq>pq)::int) rec_gt_po,
sum((bq>pq)::int) qty_over, sum((bq>pq AND rq IS NULL)::int) qty_over_no_rec, sum((bq>pq AND rq>=bq)::int) qty_over_but_received,
round(sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 AND bq>pq THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) qty_excess,
round(sum(CASE WHEN diff>0.005 AND bq>pq AND rq IS NULL THEN diff ELSE 0 END),2) qty_excess_no_rec
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) pamt, min(day) pday FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
dup AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1),
rb AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb),
short AS (SELECT b.vendor_id, p.pday, b.amount - p.pamt shortfall FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE p.pamt < b.amount-0.01),
t AS (SELECT rb.bill_id, rb.vendor_id, rb.amount, p.pday, (rb.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM dup) AND rk=2) is_dup2 FROM rb JOIN p USING(bill_id)
      WHERE (rb.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM dup) AND rk=2) OR (rb.po_id NOT IN (SELECT po_id FROM dup) AND rb.bill_id % 20 = 0)),
m AS (SELECT t.bill_id, t.is_dup2, max(CASE WHEN abs(s.shortfall - t.amount) <= 0.01*t.amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) offset_match, count(s.vendor_id) n_short
 FROM t LEFT JOIN short s ON s.vendor_id=t.vendor_id AND s.pday BETWEEN t.pday+1 AND t.pday+250 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT is_dup2, count(*) bills, sum(offset_match) offset_match, round(avg(offset_match),4) rate, round(avg(n_short),1) avg_short_bills_in_window,
 (SELECT round(sum(shortfall),2) FROM short) total_shortfall_all_bills, (SELECT count(*) FROM short) n_short_all FROM m GROUP BY 1

SELECT c.vendor_id, v.kind, count(*) n, round(sum(c.amount),2) amt, min(c.day), max(c.day),
(SELECT count(*) FROM wms_inventory_transactions w WHERE w.reason='return_vendor' AND w.ref_id=c.vendor_id) rv_txns
FROM finance_vendor_credits c JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT bill_id, sum(amount) pamt FROM finance_vendor_payments GROUP BY bill_id),
v AS (SELECT vendor_id, count(*) n2, sum((p.bill_id IS NOT NULL)::int) paid2, sum(p.pamt) paid_amt FROM b LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE rk=2 GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT vendor_id, count(*) nb, sum(amount) billed FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1)
SELECT v.vendor_id, e.kind, n2, paid2, round(paid_amt,2) paid_amt, round(paid_amt/sum(paid_amt) OVER (),4) share_dup_paid, round(billed/sum(billed) OVER (),4) share_all_billed, round(n2*1.0/nb,4) dup_rate
FROM v JOIN a USING(vendor_id) JOIN erp_vendors e USING(vendor_id) ORDER BY paid_amt DESC LIMIT 5

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM finance_vendor_payments),
x AS (SELECT po.branch, (p.bill_id IS NOT NULL)::int paid FROM b JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE rk=2 AND b.day <= 2520-45),
g AS (SELECT branch, count(*) n, sum(paid) k FROM x GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT sum(k)*1.0/sum(n) pr FROM g)
SELECT round(sum( power(k - n*pr,2)/(n*pr) + power((n-k) - n*(1-pr),2)/(n*(1-pr)) ),2) chi2, count(*)-1 df, (SELECT sum(n) FROM g) n FROM g, o

WITH rv AS (SELECT * FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='return_vendor'),
c AS (SELECT c.*, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rv WHERE rv.ref_id=c.vendor_id AND rv.sku=c.sku AND abs(-rv.qty_delta-c.qty)<1e-6 AND c.day BETWEEN rv.day AND rv.day+60) m_fix,
 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rv JOIN erp_purchase_orders po ON po.po_id=rv.ref_id WHERE po.vendor_id=c.vendor_id AND rv.sku=c.sku AND abs(-rv.qty_delta-c.qty)<1e-6 AND c.day BETWEEN rv.day AND rv.day+60) m_orig
 FROM finance_vendor_credits c)
SELECT count(*) n, sum(m_fix::int) matched_fix, round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT m_fix THEN amount END),2) unmatched_fix_amt, sum(m_orig::int) matched_orig, round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT m_orig THEN amount END),2) unmatched_orig_amt,
(SELECT string_agg(po_id||':v'||vendor_id, ',') FROM erp_purchase_orders WHERE po_id<=4) po1_4
FROM c

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM finance_vendor_payments),
x AS (SELECT d.year, b.day, (p.bill_id IS NOT NULL)::int paid FROM b JOIN dim_date d USING(day) LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE rk=2)
SELECT sum((day > 2520-41)::int) bills_within_41d_of_end, sum(CASE WHEN day > 2520-41 AND paid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unpaid_within_41d,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN day <= 2520-41 THEN paid END),4) rate_matured, sum(CASE WHEN day <= 2520-41 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_matured,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND day <= 2520-41 THEN paid END),4) rate_2025_matured, sum(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND day <= 2520-41 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_2025_matured,
 round(2670334.82+56848.98,2) net_overpaid, round((2670334.82+56848.98)/10,2) net_overpaid_per_year, round(61951.56-56848.98,2) first_shortfall_on_overlap
FROM x

WITH x AS (SELECT b.bill_id, l.sku, l.qty bq, p.qty pq, l.unit_cost bc, p.unit_cost pc, pr.unit_cost prc, l.qty*l.unit_cost-p.qty*p.unit_cost diff
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)
JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku JOIN erp_products pr ON pr.sku=l.sku
JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp ON vp.bill_id=b.bill_id AND abs(vp.amount-b.amount)<0.01)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE bq>pq) qty_over, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bq>pq AND bq-pq=1) over_by_1,
 round(median((bq-pq)/pq) FILTER (WHERE bq>pq),4) med_qty_ratio_over, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bq>pq AND bc>pc+1e-6) both_over,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(pc-prc)<1e-6) po_eq_product_cost, count(*) lines,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE bc>pc+1e-6 AND abs(bc-prc)<1e-6) overcost_eq_product_cost
FROM x

WITH d AS (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1),
b AS (SELECT b.*, vp.amount paid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.po_id ORDER BY b.day, b.bill_id) rn,
  count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY b.po_id, b.amount) same_amt
  FROM finance_vendor_bills b JOIN d USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id))
SELECT count(*) bills, count(DISTINCT po_id) pos, sum((rn>1)::int) later_bills, sum((rn>1 AND paid IS NOT NULL)::int) later_paid,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rn>1 THEN paid END),2) later_paid_amt, sum((same_amt>1)::int) bills_same_amount_as_sibling,
 count(DISTINCT vendor_invoice_no) distinct_inv_no, min(d.year)||'-'||max(d.year) yrs
FROM b JOIN dim_date d USING(day)

SELECT l.fulfilment, (l.markdown_pct>0) md, count(*) n,
 avg(abs(l.unit_price - p.list_price*(1-c.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct))<0.02) match_disc_md,
 avg(abs(l.unit_price - p.list_price*(1-c.discount_pct))<0.02) match_disc_only,
 avg(abs(l.unit_cost - p.unit_cost)<0.005) cost_eq_std,
 avg(l.unit_price/p.list_price) p2l, avg(c.discount_pct) disc
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND o.order_date>='2024-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH d AS (SELECT po_id, min(bill_id) b1 FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1),
bq AS (SELECT d.po_id, sum(bl.qty) bill_qty FROM d JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines bl ON bl.bill_id=d.b1 GROUP BY 1),
rq AS (SELECT r.po_id, sum(t.qty_delta) rec_qty FROM wms_receipts r JOIN wms_inventory_transactions t ON t.ref_id=r.receipt_id AND t.reason ILIKE '%receipt%' WHERE r.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM d) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stock_pos_with_receipt, sum((abs(rec_qty-bill_qty)<0.001)::int) rec_eq_one_bill, sum((abs(rec_qty-2*bill_qty)<0.001)::int) rec_eq_two_bills, sum((rec_qty < bill_qty-0.001)::int) rec_less
FROM rq JOIN bq USING(po_id)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT vendor_id, vendor_invoice_no FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)) reused_invoice_no,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_vendor_bills WHERE regexp_matches(vendor_invoice_no, '-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+$') AND vendor_invoice_no NOT LIKE '%-R') other_suffixes,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT reason) FROM wms_inventory_transactions) n_reasons

SELECT l.fulfilment, (l.markdown_pct>0) md, count(*) n,
 avg((abs(l.unit_price - p.list_price*(1-c.discount_pct)*(1-l.markdown_pct))<0.02)::int) match_disc_md,
 avg((abs(l.unit_price - p.list_price*(1-c.discount_pct))<0.02)::int) match_disc_only,
 avg((abs(l.unit_cost - p.unit_cost)<0.005)::int) cost_eq_std,
 avg(l.unit_price/p.list_price) p2l, avg(c.discount_pct) disc
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
WHERE p.category='equipment' AND o.order_date>='2024-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT reason, count(*) n, min(ref_id) mn, max(ref_id) mx, round(avg(qty_delta),2) avgq FROM wms_inventory_transactions GROUP BY 1

WITH d AS (SELECT po_id, min(bill_id) b1 FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1),
bq AS (SELECT d.po_id, sum(bl.qty) bill_qty FROM d JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines bl ON bl.bill_id=d.b1 GROUP BY 1),
rq AS (SELECT t.ref_id po_id, sum(t.qty_delta) rec_qty, count(DISTINCT t.day) rec_days FROM wms_inventory_transactions t WHERE t.reason='receipt' AND t.ref_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM d) GROUP BY 1),
pq AS (SELECT po_id, sum(qty) po_qty FROM erp_purchase_order_lines WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM d) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) pos_with_receipt_txns, max(rec_days) max_receipt_days, sum((abs(rec_qty-bill_qty)<0.001)::int) rec_eq_one_bill, sum((abs(rec_qty-2*bill_qty)<0.001)::int) rec_eq_two_bills, sum((rec_qty < bill_qty-0.001)::int) rec_less, sum((abs(rec_qty-po_qty)<0.001)::int) rec_eq_po
FROM rq JOIN bq USING(po_id) JOIN pq USING(po_id)

SELECT l.fulfilment, (l.markdown_pct>0) md, d.year=2025 y25, count(*) n, avg(il.unit_price/l.unit_price) inv_to_order_price, avg((abs(il.unit_price-l.unit_price)<0.01)::int) share_equal,
 sum(il.amount) inv_amt, sum(l.qty_shipped*l.unit_price) ord_amt
FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=o.day JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
JOIN finance_invoice_lines il ON il.line_id=l.line_id
WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND o.order_date>=p.discontinued_on AND d.year>=2024
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,1,2

SELECT (p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL) disc_sku, count(*) credits, sum(vc.qty) qty, sum(vc.amount) amt, min(vc.credit_date), max(vc.credit_date)
FROM finance_vendor_credits vc JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1

SELECT po.purpose, d.year, count(*) n, avg(bl.unit_cost/pl.unit_cost) bill_to_po, avg(pl.unit_cost/p.unit_cost) po_to_std, sum(b.freight) freight
FROM erp_purchase_order_lines pl JOIN erp_purchase_orders po USING(po_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=po.day
JOIN finance_vendor_bills b ON b.po_id=po.po_id JOIN finance_vendor_bill_lines bl ON bl.bill_id=b.bill_id AND bl.sku=pl.sku
WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL AND po.order_date>=p.discontinued_on AND d.year>=2024 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH bl AS (SELECT b.bill_id, b.amount, b.freight, sum(l.qty*l.unit_cost) lv, sum(p.qty*p.unit_cost) pv
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id) JOIN erp_purchase_order_lines p ON p.po_id=b.po_id AND p.sku=l.sku GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT count(*) short_bills, sum((abs(vp.amount-(pv+freight))<0.01)::int) paid_po_plus_freight, sum((abs(vp.amount-pv)<0.01)::int) paid_po_only,
 sum((lv-pv>0.005)::int) short_and_overbilled, sum((lv-pv<=0.005)::int) short_not_overbilled,
 round(sum(b2.amount-vp.amount),2) total_withheld, round(sum(lv-pv),2) total_line_excess
FROM bl JOIN finance_vendor_payments vp USING(bill_id) JOIN finance_vendor_bills b2 USING(bill_id) WHERE abs(vp.amount-bl.amount)>=0.01

SELECT count(*) skus, sum((n_cost>1)::int) skus_po_cost_varies, (SELECT count(DISTINCT fulfilment) FROM erp_sales_order_lines) nf, (SELECT string_agg(fulfilment||':'||n, ', ') FROM (SELECT fulfilment, count(*) n FROM erp_sales_order_lines GROUP BY 1)) fulf

WITH b AS (SELECT fb.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY po_id ORDER BY day, bill_id) rk FROM finance_vendor_bills fb WHERE po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM finance_vendor_bills GROUP BY po_id HAVING count(*)>1)),
p AS (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM finance_vendor_payments)
SELECT sum((b.day<=2479)::int) matured, sum((b.day<=2479 AND p.bill_id IS NOT NULL)::int) matured_paid, sum((b.day<=2479 AND p.bill_id IS NULL)::int) matured_held, round(sum(CASE WHEN b.day<=2479 AND p.bill_id IS NULL THEN amount END),2) matured_held_amt,
 sum((b.day>2479 AND p.bill_id IS NULL)::int) not_yet_due, round(sum(CASE WHEN b.day>2479 AND p.bill_id IS NULL THEN amount END),2) not_yet_due_amt
FROM b LEFT JOIN p USING(bill_id) WHERE rk=2

SELECT substr(vc.credit_date,1,4) yr, p.discontinued_on wave, count(*) n, sum(vc.qty) qty, sum(vc.amount) amt, avg(vc.amount/vc.qty/p.unit_cost) amt_per_unit_to_std,
 sum((vc.credit_date>=p.discontinued_on)::int) after_disc
FROM finance_vendor_credits vc JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
SELECT reason, count(*) n, sum(qty_delta) qty, min(txn_date), max(txn_date) FROM wms_inventory_transactions t JOIN erp_products p USING(sku) WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (SELECT b.bill_id, po.purpose, v.kind, d.year, l.qty bq, p.qty pq, l.qty*l.unit_cost-p.qty*p.unit_cost diff
FROM finance_vendor_bill_lines l JOIN finance_vendor_bills b USING(bill_id)

 (SELECT round(avg(gm),2) FROM y WHERE year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2024) avg_gm_2017_2024

WITH x AS (

 sum(CASE WHEN rk<=N*0.10 THEN n END) top10_invoices, sum(n) all_invoices,
 max(tot)/2520 avg_overdue_balance
FROM r

WITH l AS (

SELECT a.fulfilment, count(*) n,
 avg((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM l b WHERE b.order_id=a.order_id AND b.tons=a.tons AND b.sku<>a.sku AND b.qty_shipped>0))::int) other_same_tons_shipped_same_order

r AS (SELECT taken_by, channel, count(*) n, sum(uninv::int) un FROM s GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT channel, sum(un)*1.0/sum(n) p FROM r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.channel, count(*) reps, round(sum(power(un-n*p,2)/(n*p*(1-p))),1) chi2, sum(CASE WHEN abs(un-n*p)/sqrt(n*p*(1-p))>3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) reps_gt3sd,
 min(n) min_n, max(n) max_n
FROM r JOIN c USING(channel) GROUP BY 1

WITH s AS (
 SELECT l.*, o.channel, p.category, p.list_price lp, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id) uninv
 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_products p USING(sku)
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND o.channel IN ('counter','email','phone'))
SELECT channel, uninv, count(*) n, round(avg(markdown_pct),4) avg_md, round(median(qty_shipped*unit_price),2) med_val, round(avg(qty_shipped*unit_price),2) avg_val,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN qty_shipped<qty_ordered THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) partial, round(avg(unit_price/lp),4) price_to_list

SELECT count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT customer_id) d FROM (SELECT i.customer_id, sum(i.amount) b FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id GROUP BY 1)

WITH s AS (

 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=l.ship_day

SELECT 'terms' dim, channel, terms_days::varchar k, count(*) n, sum(uninv::int) un, round(100.0*sum(uninv::int)/count(*),3) pct FROM s GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL SELECT 'trade', channel, trade, count(*), sum(uninv::int), round(100.0*sum(uninv::int)/count(*),3) FROM s WHERE channel='counter' GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL SELECT 'month', channel, month::varchar, count(*), sum(uninv::int), round(100.0*sum(uninv::int)/count(*),3) FROM s WHERE channel='counter' GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH x AS (

r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY od_dd DESC) rk, count(*) OVER () nn, sum(od_dd) OVER () tot, sum(billed) OVER () totb FROM x)

 sum(CASE WHEN rk<=nn*0.05 THEN od_dd END)/max(tot) top5_share,
 sum(CASE WHEN rk<=nn*0.10 THEN od_dd END)/max(tot) top10_share,

 sum(CASE WHEN rk<=nn*0.20 THEN billed END)/max(totb) top20_billed_share,
 sum(CASE WHEN od_dd>0 THEN 1 END) cust_with_overdue,
 max(tot)/2520 avg_overdue_balance
FROM r

WITH x AS (

WITH u AS (SELECT l.* FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND l.fulfilment<>'special' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id)),
os AS (SELECT l.order_id, l.sku, sum(l.qty_shipped) shipped_all FROM erp_sales_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM u) GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT ref_id order_id, sku, -sum(qty_delta) wq, min(day) wday FROM wms_inventory_transactions WHERE reason='sale' AND ref_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM u) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN w.wq IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_wms, sum(CASE WHEN abs(w.wq-os.shipped_all)<0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wms_eq_all_shipped,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(w.wq-(os.shipped_all-u.qty_shipped))<0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wms_eq_excl_this,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.wday=u.ship_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wms_same_day
FROM u JOIN os USING(order_id, sku) LEFT JOIN w USING(order_id, sku)

WITH o AS (SELECT so.customer_id, d.year, so.order_id FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN dim_date d USING(day)),

 sum(qty_shipped*unit_price) rev, sum(qty_shipped*(unit_price-unit_cost)) gm
 FROM o JOIN erp_sales_order_lines sl USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.year, count(*) n_ret FROM erp_returns rt JOIN o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT l.*, coalesce(r.n_ret,0) n_ret, (SELECT count(*) FROM o o2 WHERE o2.customer_id=l.customer_id AND o2.year=l.year+1)=0 lapsed FROM l LEFT JOIN r USING(customer_id,year))
SELECT year, count(*) active, sum(lapsed::int) lapsed, round(avg(lapsed::int),4) rate, round(sum(CASE WHEN lapsed THEN rev END),0) lapsed_rev, round(sum(n_short)/sum(n_lines),4) short_share, sum(n_ret) rets FROM p WHERE year<=2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM finance_invoice_lines il JOIN erp_sales_order_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN finance_invoices i USING(invoice_id)

WITH x AS (
 SELECT i.customer_id, sum(i.amount) billed, sum(i.amount*greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0)) od_dd, count(*) n,
  sum(i.amount*greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0))/sum(i.amount) wlate
 FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT x.*, c.terms_days, c.credit_limit, c.trade, CASE WHEN c.terms_days=0 THEN '0 terms' WHEN wlate<6 THEN 'A prompt <6' WHEN wlate<20 THEN 'B slow 6-20' ELSE 'C very slow 20+' END seg FROM x JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id))
SELECT seg, count(*) customers, sum(n) invoices, sum(billed) billed, sum(billed)/(SELECT sum(billed) FROM s) billed_share, sum(od_dd)/(SELECT sum(od_dd) FROM s) od_share, sum(od_dd)/2520 avg_overdue_bal, sum(od_dd)/sum(billed) wlate, avg(credit_limit) avg_cl, median(credit_limit) med_cl, avg(CASE WHEN terms_days=45 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) share_45
FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (SELECT so.customer_id, d.year, so.order_id FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN dim_date d USING(day)),
cy AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, year FROM o),
l AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.year, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders, count(*) n_lines, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment='short' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_short
 FROM o JOIN erp_sales_order_lines sl USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.year, count(*) n_ret FROM erp_returns rt JOIN o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT l.*, coalesce(r.n_ret,0) n_ret, n_short/n_lines ss, (cy.customer_id IS NULL) lapsed FROM l LEFT JOIN r USING(customer_id,year) LEFT JOIN cy ON cy.customer_id=l.customer_id AND cy.year=l.year+1 WHERE l.year<=2024)
SELECT CASE WHEN n_orders<=5 THEN '1: 1-5' WHEN n_orders<=20 THEN '2: 6-20' WHEN n_orders<=100 THEN '3: 21-100' ELSE '4: 101+' END vol,
 CASE WHEN ss=0 THEN 'a 0' WHEN ss<0.05 THEN 'b <5%' WHEN ss<0.10 THEN 'c 5-10%' ELSE 'd 10%+' END sband,
 count(*) n, sum(lapsed::int) lapsed, round(avg(lapsed::int),4) rate FROM p GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH u AS (SELECT l.*, o.customer_id, o.customer_po, o.channel FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id)),
n AS (SELECT * FROM u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=u.order_id))
SELECT count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT order_id) orders, sum(CASE WHEN customer_po IS NOT NULL AND customer_po<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_po,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.customer_po=n.customer_po AND i.customer_id=n.customer_id AND n.customer_po<>'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) po_on_other_inv,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.customer_id=n.customer_id AND i.day BETWEEN n.ship_day AND n.ship_day+60 AND abs(i.amount-n.qty_shipped*n.unit_price)<0.01) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_amt_inv_60d,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_credit_memos m WHERE m.order_id=n.order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) memo
FROM n

WITH y AS (
 SELECT i.customer_id, d.year, sum(i.amount*greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0))/sum(i.amount) wlate, count(*) n
 FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=i.day JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id
 WHERE c.terms_days>0 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>=5),
z AS (SELECT a.customer_id, a.year, a.wlate w0, b.wlate w1 FROM y a JOIN y b ON a.customer_id=b.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1)

 sum(CASE WHEN w0<6 THEN 1 END) prompt_pairs, sum(CASE WHEN w0<6 AND w1<6 THEN 1 END) prompt_stay
FROM (SELECT *, rank() OVER (ORDER BY w0) rank_w0, rank() OVER (ORDER BY w1) rank_w1 FROM z)

WITH u AS (SELECT l.*, o.customer_id, o.customer_po FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.order_id=l.order_id))
SELECT u.line_id, u.order_id, u.sku, u.qty_shipped, u.ship_day, i.invoice_id, i.order_id inv_order, i.day, i.amount,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id AND il.sku=u.sku) same_sku_lines,
 (SELECT sum(qty_shipped*unit_price) FROM erp_sales_order_lines l2 WHERE l2.order_id=i.order_id) other_order_value
FROM u JOIN finance_invoices i ON i.customer_po=u.customer_po AND i.customer_id=u.customer_id WHERE u.customer_po<>''

WITH x AS (

 FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT x.customer_id, c.trade, c.branch, CASE WHEN c.terms_days=0 THEN '0 terms' WHEN wlate<6 THEN 'A' WHEN wlate<20 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END seg FROM x JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id))
SELECT s.seg, p.method, count(*) n, avg(p.day-i.due_day) avg_late, avg(CASE WHEN p.day>i.due_day THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) late_share
FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN s ON s.customer_id=i.customer_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT i.customer_id, sum(i.amount*greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0))/sum(i.amount) wlate
 FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.terms_days=0 THEN '0 terms' WHEN wlate<6 THEN 'A' WHEN wlate<20 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END seg FROM x JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id))
SELECT trade, count(*) n, avg(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) c_share, avg(CASE WHEN seg='B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) b_share, avg(CASE WHEN seg='0 terms' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) zero_share,
 avg(CASE WHEN onboarded_day<0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) pre2016
FROM s GROUP BY ROLLUP(trade) ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (SELECT so.customer_id, d.year, so.order_id FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN dim_date d USING(day)),
cy AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, year FROM o),
l AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.year, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders, count(*) n_lines, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment='short' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_short

s AS (SELECT *, avg(lapsed) OVER (PARTITION BY year, branch, trade, vb) exp_rate, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY year,branch,trade,vb) sn FROM p)

WITH s AS (

 FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=l.ship_day
 WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520)
SELECT channel, count(*) shipped, sum(uninv::int) un, round(100.0*sum(uninv::int)/count(*),3) pct,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN uninv AND year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024 THEN qty_shipped*unit_price END),2) v_16_24,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN uninv AND year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2024 THEN qty_shipped*unit_price END)/9,2) v_per_yr,

WITH o AS (SELECT so.customer_id, d.year, so.order_id FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN dim_date d USING(day)),

l AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.year, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders, count(*) n_lines, sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment='short' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_short
 FROM o JOIN erp_sales_order_lines sl USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),

FROM s WHERE sn>=5 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT i.customer_id, sum(i.amount*greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0))/sum(i.amount) wlate, sum(i.amount*greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0)) od

WITH u AS (SELECT l.*, o.customer_id FROM erp_sales_order_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE l.qty_shipped>0 AND l.ship_day<=2520 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoice_lines il WHERE il.line_id=l.line_id)),
r AS (SELECT u.line_id, sum(r.qty) rq FROM u JOIN erp_returns r ON r.line_id=u.line_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) lines, round(sum(qty_shipped*unit_price),2) gross,
 count(r.line_id) returned_lines, round(sum(coalesce(r.rq,0)*unit_price),2) returned_value,
 round(sum((qty_shipped-coalesce(r.rq,0))*unit_price),2) net_of_returns,

ln AS (SELECT o.*, (sl.fulfilment='short')::int sh FROM o JOIN erp_sales_order_lines sl USING(order_id)),

SELECT CASE WHEN n_short=0 THEN 'a 0 short' WHEN sr<1 THEN 'b <1x exp' WHEN sr<2 THEN 'c 1-2x' ELSE 'd 2x+' END band,

WITH base AS (SELECT i.customer_id, d.year, i.amount, greatest(p.day-i.due_day,0) late FROM finance_invoices i JOIN finance_customer_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=i.day JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id WHERE c.terms_days>0),
tr AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount*late)/sum(amount) wl FROM base WHERE year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2019 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=10),
s AS (SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN wl<6 THEN 'A' WHEN wl<20 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END seg FROM tr),
t AS (SELECT b.*, s.seg FROM base b JOIN s USING(customer_id) WHERE b.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024),
ra AS (SELECT sum(amount*late)/sum(amount) a_rate FROM t WHERE seg='A'),
rb AS (SELECT sum(amount*late)/sum(amount) b_rate FROM t WHERE seg='B')
SELECT a_rate, b_rate,
 (sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount END)*a_rate)/252/5 c_to_A_bal,
 (sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount END)*b_rate)/252/5 c_to_B_bal,
 (sum(CASE WHEN seg='B' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='B' THEN amount END)*a_rate)/252/5 b_to_A_bal,
 (sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount END)*a_rate)/252/5*0.08 c_to_A_8pct,
 (sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount END)*b_rate)/252/5*0.05 c_to_B_5pct,
 ((sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN amount END)*a_rate)+(sum(CASE WHEN seg='B' THEN amount*late END) - sum(CASE WHEN seg='B' THEN amount END)*a_rate))/252/5*0.08 bc_to_A_8pct,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN seg='C' THEN customer_id END) c_cust
FROM t, ra, rb GROUP BY a_rate, b_rate

WITH o AS (SELECT DISTINCT so.customer_id, d.year FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN dim_date d USING(day)),
lp AS (SELECT a.customer_id, a.year FROM o a LEFT JOIN o b ON b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.year=a.year+1 WHERE b.customer_id IS NULL AND a.year<=2024)

 LEFT JOIN o nx ON nx.customer_id=t.customer_id AND nx.year=t.year+1 WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2024)
SELECT lapsed, count(*) n_all, sum((n_t1 IS NOT NULL)::int) n_with_prior,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN n_t1 IS NOT NULL THEN n_t END)/sum(n_t1),4) ratio_t_over_t1_existing,
